Focus mode chunein
Focus set kiye hue time se countdown karta hai. Bina time limit ke padhna ho toh Stopwatch chunein. Next se practice shuru karein.
Focus ka time set karein
Settings mein preset, slider ya custom duration chunein. Practice ke liye 25 minutes rakhe hain.
Chhota break rakhein
Yahan break ka duration chunein. Practice mein 5 minutes ka break hai. Aapki real settings nahi badlengi.
Focus shuru karein
Start se focus session shuru hota hai. Next real timer chalaye bina running timer dikhayega.
Pause ya finish karein
Pause se timer rukta hai; Resume se phir chalta hai. End se session save kar sakte hain. Break se aaram ka timer chalta hai.
Session resume karein
Resume se paused session continue hota hai. Pause karne ka matlab session end ya save karna nahi hai.
Break lein
Focus ke dauraan Break se rest timer shuru hota hai. End break se focus par lautein. Next session mein waapas jaana dikhayega.
Focus aur rest balance karein
Aap practice focus session mein waapas hain. Zaroorat par Break lein. Next session finish karna dikhayega.
Kaam hone par finish karein
End se session organize karne se pehle confirmation khulta hai. Practice time aage badha diya hai, wait nahi karna padega.
End confirm karein
Continue se timer end hokar save flow khulta hai. Cancel se focus continue karein. Next, Continue dikhayega.
Apne kaam ko naam dein
Optional session name aur subject tag add karein. Alag save karein ya pehle goal link karein. Yeh sirf sample data hai.
Save se pehle check karein
Confirm karne se pehle save destination aur completion choice check karein. Practice confirmation kisi goal, topic ya account data ko nahi badalta.
Recorded time dekhein
History mein saved sessions aur focus time dikhta hai. Practice entry read-only hai aur exit karte hi hat jayegi.
Bina countdown ke focus
Stopwatch time count up karta hai. Start, Pause, Resume aur End waise hi kaam karte hain. Finish par elapsed time save kar sakte hain.
Focus cycles try karein
Settings se Pomodoro kholein taaki focus aur rest alternate hon. Next practice setup kholega.
Traditional Pomodoro
Traditional is setup mein dikhaya rhythm use karta hai. Duration aur loops khud chunne ke liye Custom chunein.
Apne cycles set karein
Custom mein focus minutes, break minutes aur loops set karein. Example mein 25 / 5 aur four loops hain. Next running cycle dikhayega.
Focus, rest, repeat
Timer configured Pomodoro cycle follow karta hai. Normal controls se pause, resume ya end kar sakte hain.
Kavach ready karein
Focus se pehle Kavach enable karein aur distracting apps chunein. Usage access aur display-over-other-apps permissions chahiye. Practice koi permission nahi deta.
Block karne wale apps chunein
Jin apps ko block karna hai unke switches chalu karein, phir Save apps dabayein. Lambi list mein search aur selection buttons madad karte hain. Yeh sirf sample apps hain.
Protection status dekhein
Ready ka matlab setup ready hai. Active ka matlab protection chal raha hai. Always On session ke baahar bhi protect kar sakta hai; unavailable ho toh setup check karein.
YouTube Focus se padhein
Yeh shortcut YouTube Focus setup kholta hai. Wahan permission guide follow karke study content chunein. Practice shortcut tutorial ke andar rahega.
Focus audio chunein
Music se audio library kholein. Categories browse karke track chunein. Normal use mein preview audio bajata hai; practice silent rahegi.
Backdrop chunein
Theme se timer backdrop badalta hai. Focus mein help karne wala look chunein. Practice aapki saved theme nahi badlegi.
Session audio control karein
Settings ke Audio ya overflow menu ke volume action se mute aur unmute karein.
Timer alert chunein
Timer alert ke liye Sound ya Vibrate chunein. Reliable alerts ke liye Android alarm access chahiye ho sakta hai; permission flow practice ke baahar kholein.
Break automatically shuru karein
Focus finish hote hi rest shuru karne ke liye automatic breaks enable karein. Khud break start karna ho toh ise off rakhein.
Time nazar mein rakhein
Overflow menu mein Enable floating timer ya Floating timer settings chunein. Android overlay permission chahiye.
Doosre apps ke upar timer
Setup ke baad doosre apps use karte waqt floating timer se time dekhein. Yeh in-app example hai, real overlay nahi.
Save se pehle goal link karein
Save flow mein open goal chunein. Kaam baaki ho toh goal open rakhein. Usi session ka time goal se link hoga.
Poora hone par goal done karein
Goal finish ho tabhi completion option chunein. Time save karna aur goal complete karna alag choices hain. Yeh sample goal real nahi hai.
Planner topic ka time record karein
Planner topic se started session usi topic se linked rehta hai. Topic open rakhte hue time save kar sakte hain.
Sochkar topic complete karein
Topic ka study work finish hone par hi complete karein. Save se pehle confirmation dekhein.
Sahi session list chunein
Ekagra aur Stopwatch categories mein sessions dekhein. Session name, tags aur goal association save flow mein chunein.
Din ya subject dhoondhein
History mein All, Today ya date chunein, phir subject tags se list narrow karein. Filters sirf dikhne wali list badalte hain.
Study Circles kholein
Jab aap kisi circle mein nahi hain, Join Group se Study Circles khulte hain. Menu se bhi Study Circles khol sakte hain.
Apne circle ke saath focus karein
Judne ke baad timer par lautein. Circle badalne ke liye group card dabakar rakhein. Live se focus kar rahe logon ki sankhya dikhti hai.

Is step ki jaankari
Samajh gaya
Control nahi dikh raha. Retry dabayein.
Apni pasand ki settings
Focus aur break ka time badalne ke liye Settings kholein.
Settings mein focus aur break dono ka time badal sakte hain. Alerts, apne aap break aur Pomodoro bhi yahin chunein.
Audio aur theme chunein
Apni pasand ke liye Music aur Theme kholein.
Music mein track ya silence chunein. Theme se timer ka background badlein. Dono optional hain.
Kavach ki settings kholein
Menu se Kavach kholein aur With Ekagra chunein.

With Ekagra focus session mein protection deta hai. Phir block karne wale apps chunein. Usage access aur dusre apps ke upar dikhane ki permission chahiye; zarurat ho to alag permission guides dekhein.
Circle se judein
Join with code ya public circle par Join chunein.
Private circle ka code dost se lein ya list se public circle chunein. Is guide mein kisi asli circle se nahi judenge.
Ya apna circle banayein
Create circle chunein, phir Public ya Private chunein.
Public circles dusre log dhoondh sakte hain. Private circles mein code se judte hain. Circle banane ke liye aapke plan mein access chahiye ho sakta hai. Practice mein koi circle nahi banega.
Madad
